item.title: Pir 0.1.6
item.description:
Pir 0.1.6

  • 图片工具条采用均匀半透明圆角背景
  • 图片显示模式切换采用连续尺寸过渡
  • fit 留白图片显示虚线边框
  • 虚线边框增加紧贴轮廓的暗色对比, 改善白底和深底上的可见性
  • 修复进入透明图片边缘时的缩放光标更新

English

  • Image controls use a uniform translucent rounded background
  • Image display modes transition through continuous resizing
  • Images with fit letterboxing show a dashed frame
  • Dashed outlines gain a compact dark contrast treatment for light and dark backgrounds
  • Resize cursors update when entering transparent image edges

item.title: Pir 0.1.5
item.description:
Pir 0.1.5

  • 左侧工具条采用关闭、复原、缩放模式、复制顺序, 关闭按钮位于最左侧
  • 复制成功时显示平滑过渡的勾选图标, 随后恢复复制按钮
  • 图片支持裁剪填充与完整等比显示两种模式, 模式随会话保存

English

  • Upper-left controls start with Close, followed by Restore, image scaling, and Copy
  • Successful copies show an animated checkmark before restoring the copy icon
  • Image pins switch between cover and fit, with the selected mode saved across restarts

item.title: Pir 0.1.4
item.description:
Pir 0.1.4

  • 修复贴屏移动后的尺寸、位置与显示器归属记忆
  • 控制区移至左上, 优化透明图片边缘缩放、圆角阴影、虚线与悬停动画
  • 文件贴屏支持相交框选、打开、废纸篓、简介与重命名, 文件引用跨浮窗同步
  • 正式启动保持静默, 默认快捷键采用 Shift + Command + V
  • 欢迎窗口居中, 开始按钮放大, 烟花位置随机且范围增大

English

  • Reliable move and display placement persistence
  • Upper-left controls, transparent edge resizing, rounded contrast backgrounds, and hover transitions
  • Finder-style file selection and actions with synchronized references
  • Quiet release launches and a Shift + Command + V default shortcut
  • Centered onboarding, a larger start button, and larger randomized fireworks

item.title: Pir 0.1.3
item.description:
Pir 0.1.3

  • 文件图标放大并紧凑排列, 窗口高度按内容适配
  • 文本与文件浮窗采用毛玻璃背景, 文件浮窗隐藏复制按钮, 文本复制图标缩小
  • 恢复悬停按钮的径向阴影, 透明图片保留虚线边界
  • 贴屏页采用混合内容空态插图, 快捷键帮助按钮缩小, 状态栏图标与应用 Logo 一致

Larger file icons with compact spacing and content-sized windows. Text and file pins use a translucent material. Refined hover controls, a mixed-content empty state, a smaller help button, and a menu bar icon matching the app logo.

item.title: Pir 0.1.2
item.description:
Pir 0.1.2

图片、可编辑文本和文件随手贴屏. 支持中英文、图标与列表文件视图、双击打开、原生文件拖拽和会话恢复.

Pin images, editable notes and files. Includes English and Chinese, file views, native drag and drop, persistent sessions and signed updates.
